description: LST GIS-stöd för planering och tillsyn av små avlopp - alla skikt (tjänst) is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ext-geodata-nationella-visning.lansstyrelsen.se. The purpose of the GIS support is to create conditions at a national level for a reasonable, legally certain and more uniform assessment of the level of protection under Chapter 2, Section 3 of the Environmental Code when examining small sewers. Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "LST GIS support for planning and supervising small sewers - all layers (service)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2024-12-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://resources.geodata.se/codelist/metadata/anvandningsrestriktioner.xml#CC01.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
